p1-about-me: Hello! I am Sergio. I live in Rotterdam and specialize in tattooing a style that combines blackwork with realism. My passion for the details of blackwork, along with the more detailed depth and texture of realism, allows me to create unique tattoos that not only stand out but also tell a story.
p2-about-me: My approach is to seamlessly integrate these two styles, ensuring that each piece reflects my clients' individuality while maintaining a timeless aesthetic. My work is characterized by its high contrast, meticulous attention to detail, and a keen sense of how designs adapt and flow with the body's natural contours.
p3-about-me: Through my tattoos, I aim to bring my clients' visions to life, creating art that resonates with their personal narratives and enhances their natural beauty.
tattoos-sub: Here you can see some of my tattoos.
p1-appointment-policy: As your tattoo artist, I appreciate your trust in letting me create a lasting piece of art on your skin. Here are our deposit and cancellation policies:
p2-appointment-policy: After our initial talk, you'll need to make a non-refundable deposit to confirm your tattoo session. This shows you're serious about going through with the artistic journey we're planning together.
p3-appointment-policy: Life happens, and I get that plans can shift. Here's what you can do:
p3a-bold-appointment-policy: Free Changes up to 1 Week Before:
p3a-appointment-policy: You can change or reschedule your appointment without any cost if you do it at least three days before your session.
p3b-appointment-policy: While you can't get your deposit back, it reserves your place. If you have to cancel, you can use the deposit for a future appointment, following our rules.
p4-appointment-policy: Thanks for sticking to these rules, which help keep things running smoothly for everyone. I'm excited to work with you on creating meaningful art!
